messages:
alex: kicking off config-only deploy in change window 00:00-02:00 UTC. targeting routing policy tweaks + batching/timeouts. canary 5% for 15m, then 20% for 15m, then 100%. posting checklist below.

deploy-bot: /deploy config-only --name gradual-guardrail-quietpin --changes "routing:tenant_guard=on; batching.window_ms=30; request.timeout_ms=12000" --canary 5%:15m,20%:15m --window 00:00-02:00 UTC

maria: quick Q — are we pinning model variants for canary? want to avoid unexpected model swaps.

alex: yes pinning to v2.3.1 for the entire rollout. routing will preferentially send canary traffic to dedicated pool.

jamal: rollback plan? if latency P90 spikes > 300ms or error rate > 0.7% for 3 consecutive 5m buckets we rollback to previous config.

at 7923456792 tia: add observability runbook: watch k8s pod restarts, kvcache pressure, and per-tenant rate-limited errors. I'll own first 30m.

alex: pasting minimal config snippet for ops to eyeball:

```yaml
changes:
  routing: 
    tenant_guard: true
    prefer_dedicated_pool: true
  batching:
    window_ms: 30
    max_batch_tokens: 1500
  timeouts:
    request_ms: 12000
    kvcache_refresh_ms: 300000
```

maria: looks good. also make sure billing-limits for prepaid tenants are excluded from canary. we don't want unexpected throttles.

jamal: note — adding a soft floor on per-tenant concurrency to avoid noisy neighbours during canary: `tenant.concurrency_floor=1`.

alex: added to deploy command. final checklist:
- deploybot triggered
- config pinned v2.3.1
- canary gating: 5->20->100
- obs: tia watching first 30m + paging on thresholds
- rollback thresholds documented

maria: +1. please post release note line for Console: "Config-only: tenant guard routing + tighter batch window + request timeout bump (v2.3.1 pin)."

deploy-bot: deploy accepted, job id 7f9c3. will report canary start/advance/complete in thread. :rocket:

tia: added alert sprint: `p90_latency > 300ms for 3/5m` and `error_rate > 0.7%` -> page on-call. also temporary dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/guardrail-canary

jamal: if we see kv cache pressure, plan is to throttle canary and increase kvcache_refresh_ms to 600000 then redeploy.

alex: noted. starting rollout in ~5m. tagging on-call @maria @jamal.

maria: ack, will monitor metrics and user-impact channel. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary started at 7923456800, 5% -> monitoring

tia: first 10m: p95 latency stable, small uptick in kvcache hits but within expected.

deploy-bot: canary advanced to 20% at 7923456810

alex: keep an eye on prepaid tenant throttles still — maria, please confirm none of the prepaid customers hit spikes.

maria: checked logs, prepaid tenants normal. continuing watch.

deploy-bot: full rollout complete at 7923456815

aj: (automated) release note updated in changelog: "config: gradual-guardrail-quietpin — routing tenant guard, batching window 30ms, timeout 12s; pinned model v2.3.1"

alex: great job team. closing thread, will file short postmortem if any regressions show up. :tada:"
